Jimmy Callahan

Positions: Leftfielder, Pitcher and Third Baseman

Bats: Right  •  Throws: Right

5-10, 180lb (178cm, 81kg)

Born: March 18, 1874 in Fitchburg, MA us

Died: October 4, 1934 in Boston, MA

Buried: St. Bernard Cemetery, Fitchburg, MA

Debut: May 12, 1894 (Age 20-055d, 1,782nd in major league history)

Last Game: August 9, 1913 (Age 39-144d)

Rookie Status: Exceeded rookie limits during 1897 season

Full Name: James Joseph Callahan

Nicknames: Nixey

Frequently Asked Questions

When was Jimmy Callahan born?

Jimmy Callahan was born on March 18, 1874.

Where was Jimmy Callahan born?

Jimmy Callahan was born in Fitchburg, MA.

How tall was Jimmy Callahan?

Jimmy Callahan was 5-10 (178 cm) tall.

How much did Jimmy Callahan weigh when playing?

Jimmy Callahan weighed 180 lbs (81 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Jimmy Callahan play?

Jimmy Callahan played 13 seasons.

Is Jimmy Callahan in the Hall of Fame?

Jimmy Callahan has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

What position did Jimmy Callahan play?

Jimmy Callahan was a Leftfielder, Pitcher and Third Baseman.

How many hits did Jimmy Callahan have?

Jimmy Callahan had 901 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Jimmy Callahan have?

Jimmy Callahan had 11 home runs over his career.

What was Jimmy Callahan's average?

Jimmy Callahan had a .273 average over his career.

How many teams has Jimmy Callahan played for?

Jimmy Callahan played for 3 teams; the Chicago Orphans, Chicago White Sox and Philadelphia Phillies.

When did Jimmy Callahan retire?

Jimmy Callahan last played in 1913.

What are Jimmy Callahan's nicknames?

Nixey is a nickname for Jimmy Callahan.
